If Noelvi Marte is scratched or not included in the starting lineup, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Noelvi Marte starts the game but does not record a plate appearance, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Noelvi Marte is not in the starting lineup but later enters the game, the market will resolve to the fair market price, pinch hit at bats will not count towards the market.
If Noelvi Marte is in the starting lineup and records at least one plate appearance the market will settle based on hits recorded.
